description: Attach one of the user's existing gallery images to a tracked world-graph entity in a campaign, so it shows on that entity. image_id comes from chargen_search_gallery or chargen_get_generation. Re-attaching the same image updates only its title and caption (omitting them clears them); its position on the entity is kept. Free.

caption.description: Optional caption shown with the image on the entity

entity_id.description: UUID of a tracked world-graph entity in that campaign (chargen_list_entities)

image_id.description: UUID of one of the user's own gallery images (not a video or audio item)

title.description: Optional title shown with the image on the entity

name: chargen_attach_image
title: Attach image to campaign entity
